text.font-family: 'Noto Sans JP','Noto Sans CJK JP','Hiragino Sans','Yu Gothic','Meiryo',sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Noto Sans JP','Noto Sans CJK JP','Hiragino Sans','Yu Gothic','Meiryo',sans-serif
